title: Tactical ops: quant onboarding vignettes
summary: Weekly field vignettes summarizing small experiments, surprising failure modes during quantized model onboarding, and tactical mitigations to keep model quality within SLO while reducing cost.
body:
Context and goal:
This is a compact capture from today's applied-ml sync: rapid onboarding of quantized variants (q4_0/q8_0 style) for candidate open checkpoints, plus focused eval runs that try to catch distributional failures (QA, instruction-following, and summarization). The objective is to triage quality regressions early and produce small, reproducible mitigations (prompt adapters, prefix stashing, simple calibration) rather than long-run re-training.

Attendees:
- Ethan Wallace (owner)
- Priya Nair (evals lead)
- Sofia Martinez (runtime/kv-cache)
- Liam O'Connor (serving)
- Anna Becker (product liaison, short)

Agenda:
1) Quick status of quant onboarding attempts this week
2) Two failure vignettes we saw + root-cause hypotheses
3) Action items and short experiments (1–3 day scope)
4) Notes for rollout gating checklist

1) Status snapshot:
- Candidate checkpoints: oss-llm-v4-30b, barnes-13b-rev2, ostrich-7b.
- Quant variants generated via local builder: q4_0 and q8_0 candidates for each. Build infra: build-quant-03, using quant-tool v0.9.2.
- Eval harness: eval-harness v2.1.5, runs on ephemeral runners with 4-shot instruction suite + summarization subset.
- Preliminary perf: q8_0 variants show 1.9x token throughput, median token latency down ~35% compared to fp16; q4_0 shows ~3.6x throughput but with varying quality drop.

2) Two failure vignettes (detailed):
A) Token-shift hallucination on summarization (oss-llm-v4-30b q4_0)
- Symptom: Summaries occasionally repeat a phrase 2–3x and insert unrelated facts. Observed in 4/120 runs (non-deterministic).
- Quick repro: seed=4421, prompt id SUMM-23, temp=0.0, max_tokens=150.
- Hypothesis: aggressive quantization + KV-cache alignment mismatch. When cached KV slices are reused across different sequence lengths, small numeric drift pushes attention distribution to favor n-gram repetition.
- Evidence: disabling KV-cache removes repeats in the same seed run; running with deterministic attention dropout mask (runtime flag: --force-deterministic-attn) also reduces occurrences.
- Short mitigation: enable conservative KV-cache alignment for q4_0 builds (pad keys to 64-byte boundary and use 32-bit accumulation for accumulation path). Implemented as runtime patch on build-quant-03; patch id PR#82.
- Next: run 10k summarization micro-evals with KV-cache patched (Priya) and measure token-repetition rate and ROUGE-L delta vs fp16 baseline.

B) Instruction-following drop on short QA (barnes-13b-rev2 q8_0)
- Symptom: concise direct-answer questions produce lower exact-match; the model returns overly verbose context instead of the short answer. Seen in 12/200 runs.
- Hypothesis: quantized logits frequency scaling changed softmax sharpness leading to a higher entropy tail; beam/greedy selection prefers longer completions.
- Evidence: comparing logits distribution for target tokens between fp16 and q8_0 shows consistent softmax temperature-like widening (KL divergence ~0.12).
- Short mitigation: apply logit temperature correction at serving (per-model param: logits_scale=1.07 discovered experimentally). Also add a prompt-level hint to prefer terse answers ("Brief answer:").
- Next: A/B test with serving rollout (canary 5% traffic) after automated eval shows improved EM without latency regression. Serve change owner: Liam.

3) Short experiment matrix (1–3 day scope):
- E1: KV-cache alignment patch A/B: run 10k summarization micro-evals (Priya), measure repetition-rate, ROUGE, and p95 token latency. Goal: repetition-rate <= baseline + 0.5%.
- E2: Logit scaling sweep for barnes-13b-rev2 q8_0: sweep [0.98,1.03,1.07,1.12], 5 seeds each, eval on short QA suite. Track EM, F1, and latency. (Owner: Ethan).
- E3: Prompt adapter checklist: minimal hinting templates for terse answers, few-shot exemplars for instruction-following (Sofia to run).
- E4: Microbatch vs continuous-batch latency tradeoffs on q4_0: run perf with batch sizes [1,2,4,8] and continuous batching window [10ms,50ms,100ms]. Capture p50/p95 and throughput. (Owner: Sofia + SRE).

4) Rollout gating checklist additions (quick wins):
- Add a micro-eval suite for repetition detection (n-gram repeat ratio) to gating.
- Require KL-of-logits test between fp16 baseline and quant variant; flag >0.08 as caution zone.
- Add a KV-cache stress test: sequence-length tail runs at 1k tokens with interleaved short sequences to mimic multi-tenant reuse.
- Require a one-page note in the onboarding PR summarizing any runtime patches needed (e.g., kv-padding, accumulation-mode change, logits_scale).

Open questions / discussion items:
- Is the current quant toolkit deterministic enough to attribute failures to quant vs runtime? We need more deterministic builds (repro seeds across machines). Action: engineering infra to add reproducible-quant-build pipeline (Liam + infra).
- When do we prefer small runtime fixes vs rolling back to q8_0? Decision rule proposed: if quality metric delta > 2.0% absolute on core evals, prefer rollback. Otherwise apply runtime mitigation and monitor 48h.

Decisions made in sync:
- Push KV-cache alignment patch to q4_0 canary (5% traffic) after Priya's micro-evals hit targets.
- Apply logits_scale=1.07 as default for barnes-13b-rev2 q8_0 in canary rollout; monitor EM delta hourly for first 6 hours.

Action items with owners and due dates:
- Priya: run 10k summarization micro-evals with KV patch and report: due 2026-10-01.
- Ethan: run logit scaling sweep and compile results + recommend default: due 2026-10-02.
- Sofia: perf runs (microbatching vs continuous) and update perf dashboard: due 2026-10-03.
- Liam: prepare canary config and rollback playbook for serving change: due 2026-10-04.
- Anna: update product rollout note and customer-impact statement for onboarding: due 2026-10-05.

Notes for future writeups (short):
- Capture a minimal reproducible script for the KV-cache repeat bug; stash in github under experiments/kv-repeat. Include deterministic seed and runtime flags.
- Add a small section in onboarding PR template: "Known quant caveats" (list of heuristics & mitigations).

Misc quick captures from the bench runs:
- q4_0 on ostrich-7b: perplexity on Wikitext-2 up +6.2% but ROUGE on summarization only down 0.9% — interesting discrepancy (maybe dataset mismatch).
- Memory footprint improved 38% median; GPU utilization for q8_0 improved by ~22% across p2 nodes.

Risks & notes:
- Some runtime patches are fragile across different microarchitectures (A100 vs H100); we need to add hw-variant regression in CI.
- Customer-facing communication: delay public mention of quant rollout until 1 week post canary if any mitigations are applied.

Appendix (quick links & reproduc):
- Repro script stub: github.com/redwood-inference/experiments/kv-repeat (see README for seed and flags)
- Build infra: build-quant-03 (quant-tool v0.9.2)
- PR reference for runtime patch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/quant-probe/pull/82

End of capture. Will re-sync next Thurs standup; interim async updates to the ticket JIRA:AM-4123.
